'''Spaceworld''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] used to advertise the [[Spaceworld/Legends|source of entertainment]] of the same on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was put up around [[Galactic City/Legends|the city]] and showed an abstract motif with a black, grey and white [[Color/Legends|color]] scheme, speckled with red. The name ''Spaceworld'' was painted in red [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] at the bottom.<ref name="Lethal" /> The poster was put up in a [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]],<ref name="Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> in [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]],<ref name="Lethal" /> in an [[Unidentified Coruscant cantina/Legends|unidentified cantina]]<ref name="Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> and in the [[Refresher/Legends|latrine]] at the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] bar [[79's/Legends|79's]].<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>
